reviews.text: Everyone there is so friendly and great with the dogs. I am so grateful I found Bark Park!!!

I honestly cannot recommend Houston Bark Park enough. Sending Bear here has been an absolute game changer for us. Before he started daycare, he was super hesitant and anxious around other dogs, but he has completely transformed
The staff here is incredible. They’re so patient and actually pay attention to the dogs, which helped Bear build up his confidence at his own pace. He trusts other dogs so much more now, and his socialization has skyrocketed. Plus, he gets to completely sprint around the yards and burn off all that energy playing with new friends, enjoying the splash pads and diving into a sea of bubbles from the cannon. He comes home absolutely wiped out, totally content, and ready to just crash and cuddle for the night. If you’re looking for a place where your dog will actually be cared for and grow, this is 100% it.
Staff was prepared for my dogs first visit and we’re over friendly and prepared! They delivered on all promises and my dog had a very good day considering she is afraid of most dogs.

Our sweet Nala started daycare with Houston Bark Park at 5 months old. She’s a skiddish pup, but after a short amount of time she began confidently jumping out of the car excited to go to daycare.

She has made many pup friends. Playing with fellow pups is important for our active Nala. She is also warmly recognized and regularly greeted by staff.

In addition to multiple days a week of daycare, Nala also enrolls in Academy where classes are small and provide her space with HBP trainers for new learning and skills. She loves her teachers!

The staff and trainers at HBP are lovely, helpful, and efficient. They make scheduling and coordination easy. Nala’s positive acclimation to daycare and Academy helped us feel at ease in testing out boarding and grooming services at HBP. We can’t say enough good things about her experiences here.

Nala’s relationship to Houston Bark Park has brought much joy for her and her Mommies. We are grateful to the HBP Team, and highly recommend!

After many years with these people on the Energy Corridor facility we never a problem and raved about the staff. When it closed we went to the Maxie the only option. We were watching on camera for or our English Pointer at play time. We saw our English Cocker on camera. When we called about this we were told he had the zoomies and was put up to decompress. He just turned 3 and is full of energy and always will be I hope to God. Because they didn’t make any effort to let him run for 2 minutes for his Zoomies and put him back in the suite we always reserve I can’t believe that happened for 5 days. We have 4 dogs in our family and they have lost all our business. Speaking to the manager was like talking to a prerecorded message.
I would have given them a one except one of our dogs enjoyed his stay as far as we could tell other than being without his house brother.

I have been taking my little Tina to HBP (Maxie location) for 2 years and they are absolutely fantastic! The staff are all incredibly friendly and genuinely love and care for the dogs so much. I never worry about anything when I drop Tina off and she is always super excited for daycare. Thank you, HBP!

Everyone is super nice and friendly and it’s very apparent that they love and care about every dog.  My dog gets super excited every time I take her for daycare and she always comes home tired…which I love!
My fur baby absolutely loves Bark Park Maxie. He runs to get inside the door.
Took my Santo for reevaluation.. he had a ball.

we LOVE HBP my dog Timmy has a blast every single time he goes! Pricing is very fair and the staff are amazing Hensley Emily and the entire HBP team treat us like family. When we first adopted our dog we sent him to a different daycare facility and he never seemed to have fun but at HBP he never wants to leave!! THANK YOU HBP FOR LOVING OUR BOY!!

Yesterday I took my dog for the temperament test day. The staff were so kind. Joana soo extra time to reassure me and make sure I was done crying (lol) before I left. They called several times throughout the day to update me. Zeus was rescued off the street and he has a lot of energy (friendly but wild) so I was nervous. He completed a full day with no issues. Their manager followed up with me at the end to give any and all recommendations and I also received a report card with pictures of Zeus.  It was really nice to be able to log on and see him throughout the day. He went right to sleep on the way home and when we got home. Thank you so much! Zeus can’t wait to come back🤍🤍🤍🤍

P.s it’s always greatly appreciated when military discounts are offered🤍

I have been visiting HBP for 3+ years now and my Siberian husky Lola loves her time at daycare. I know the staff loves her and she’s in good hands. I love that there are cameras which allows me to check in on her, which gives me peace of mind when I miss her during our boarding sessions. We love participating in the fun photo shoots and I’m so thankful for the grooming services so we can get her tired + clean! 😊 thank you HBP Maxie!

We LOVE Houston Bark Park on Maxie St! Our dog has been going here about once a week for a few years now, and they are always so sweet and take such good care of our boy! He always comes home tired and happy! They're very careful to make sure the dogs don't overheat, and they've always been very accommodating of our baby's storm anxiety. All the staff are so kind and friendly, especially Joanna!

We also love that we can check the cameras to see how he's doing, and when we board him, they give great report cards with lots of cute pictures. It's so nice to have somewhere we can trust with our baby!

This place is great! My dog loves going everytime we take a vacation. The staff is very friendly. They have cameras and I love getting to see my dog enjoying her time there. I think my dogs favorite thing is the bubble cannon!

Update - My two dogs really enjoy Bark Park. My youngest dog was a rescue that was rescued by Bark Park. Both dogs frequently go to bark park and it has always been positive. Recently, my older dog had to undergo a surgery. We boarded the younger dog during this process. The staff was extremely compassionate and asked for updates about the older dog and kept me updated on my younger dog. They made a stressful situation much less stressful. These are little details that keep us coming back to Bark Park.

Been bringing Fred to Maxie location for about 4 years.  Always, had great experience. Fred seems very happy to arrive each time. Since I am a veterinarian, I am very much in tune with dog care and boarding since one on my practices did it for 30 years. I applaud what Bark Park does.

We really enjoyed the place but we were just notified that they require re-temperment testing every 3 months if you don't visit in that time frame. Important thing to note, if you are not boarding frequently. I won't be able to go back here since this is a service I only need a couple of times a year. Most other places have a one-year temperament test requirement.

I felt at ease bringing my 2 golden doodles here with reasonable prices, friendly/familiar staff, large play parks and personalized touches- 2 years ago. I am a dog owner who brings my dogs here as a special day; to play once a week because they are happy,  loving dogs who love outside time, being active, social and get along beautifully with other dogs (they both got A+ across the board on their first day report cards). Within the last year, things have changed. Prices are higher for less customer service and community feel. $5 charges here and there for forgetting to scan your dog out (even though front desk is attended by staff who sit in front of computer and watch you), bringing your own kibble for lunch, etc. Pay more and upgrade to academy training but I did not think that was worth it. I was never offered a tour of the inside facility so question the conditions inside and cannot speak to that. Staff changes like a revolving door sadly. They have a hard time keeping good folks. Those who are primarily working with the dogs in the parks now are young kids and do not have any formal training in basic dog correction, dog behavior etc. Lots of incident reports to CYA now for example: playful puppy nipping or jumping when overly stimulated but no mention of correcting the behavior when it happens in the moment. Meanwhile, no incident report or concern expressed when you notice scratches on your dog after pick up. An older, less playful and fully obedience trained dog would do best here now but then... what is the real purpose of a structured doggy daycare facility vs. leaving your dog in a somewhat supervised yard for $40+ dollars?

The best day care ever!! The workers at this location are the best. Koda has been going to daycare here for about two years and LOVES it. He’s a rescue and can be a bit nervous at times but everyone here makes him feel so comfortable and loved. I appreciate that they conduct temperament test to ensure safety for all dogs. He’s met so many new friends and whimpers from excitement when we pull into the parking lot. Couldn’t recommend this place more!

I absolutely love Houston Bark Park and Daycare! Max Galito has been going here for two years now, and it always feel like he is very taken care of when he's with this team. Everyone there is so kind and I appreciate how they always answer any questions I have and always let me know how Max is doing when he is there for daycare or when I use their boarding options. I never worry that something will happen to him which is a big deal for me because I think of my dog as my puppy son and I won't leave him with just anyone. I highly recommend Houston Bark Park (all locations). The best part? Each year my dog gets a free daycare day for his birthday which we just used this week, and there are so many opportunities for cute photos for almost every holiday. Thank you Houston Bark Park!
I have been taking my fur babies to Bark park for over 8 years and they have consistently been awesome with my pups.  I love them!

My pup Ryder truly loves going to Houston Bark Park and loves everyone on the team. The team knows your pup by name and treats them as if they are their own. Every chance I have to tell someone about HBP I do. They are truly unmatched. Just yesterday my pup jumped out of the car before I got his leash on bc he was so excited to get inside and play.

I trust this team with my boy both for daycare and boarding. They’re exceptional.

We had a great first time experience at Houston Bark Park and the facilities are fantastic. The staff was professional and courteous and the pricing is in line with most other places.  They even made a specific accommodation for our particular needs.  Can’t wait to send our pups back there for playtime and all around fun!
Cici is a very good groomer. She makes the dogs smell so good. Great job cici.
Great staff and facilities. Almost too good because my dog gets way too excited every time he realizes he’s going there.
Everyone here is so nice and friendly.  Great place for my pets

I love taking my pup to this daycare! He usually has a hard time jumping out of the car due to hesitation, but whenever I bring him here he jumps right out! The staff is always so kind and helpful! My pup always walks away with them without looking back. He comes back tired and ready for a big nap. The cameras also help me ease some of my worries! They are also very communicative when it comes to my pup such as a needed nail trim or just a small update when I pick him up. Definitely recommend this daycare to anyone that’s interested!
Me and my dog love this park!

Thank you for taking such good care of Hershey she had a great time!!
The Hartmans
Piper loves going to HBP Maxie location ! She gets excited when we drive up and sees all the other dogs … thank you for loving on her 💕 …

This is only a company of such kind I can trust my dogs to. Over many years, on many occasions, I've gotten assured that their business has high standards of operation and morals. They not only provide excellent care for the dogs but also deeply care of the dogs' owners, and implemented many ways for them to be always updated on the well being of their pups.
My dogs LOVE this place! The staff and activities are wonderful. I love that they actually know my dogs and their personalities. Highly recommend.

My dog Aspen loves going to daycare! Everyone at the Maxie location is so sweet and takes great care of her. She always walks out tired because she played so much which is a good thing! I’m excited to bring her younger brother there in a couple of months!

My dogs had an absolute blast at Houston Bark Parks Acadamy class.  From the daily activities to the small pack playtime, everything was perfect.  The team is very helpful, and you can tell they care about the dogs in their care.  My boys will definitely be back!!!
Friendly staff and excellent facilities!! 10 / 10, must recommend

I took my two dogs for their first visit- to the Maxie location-  yesterday.  They had their reactivity testing to see if they were friendly enough to join the pack for daycare.  I watched them from home  on the on-site cameras most of the day- it was totally addicting!  The staff was so attentive, the play yard was huge and all the fun extra features they have were used all day- the bubble cannon, the water features.  The staff would go to my dogs and love on them if they looked like they needed it.  It was a huge success.  Very very impressed with the professionalism I saw and how clean and fun the play yards all were.

Overall just a great experience and the pricing is very reasonable. My dog, Zyah is shy but loves once she warms up. I could check the cameras to see she was mostly keeping to herself but having fun and getting pets from staff. Most importantly, she slept great that night! Peep the cute report card you get on admission day 🥹 …

I can’t say enough good things about this dog boarding school! I love that they have turf, so my dog always comes home clean and not covered in mud. It’s a huge relief, especially on rainy days! My Goldendoodle comes home absolutely exhausted after all the playtime, which I love because I know he’s had a full day of fun and exercise. Plus, he’s always so excited when we pull up for drop-off — he can’t wait to get out of the car! It’s clear that the staff really cares and goes the extra mile to make sure the dogs are happy and comfortable. Highly recommend to any pet owner looking for a clean, well-managed boarding option with lots of playtime!”
Great experience! Staff is always friendly, cameras are always on, pick and drop of as easy as 1, 2, 3.
Love this place. So kind and friendly.  Milo loves it here. He comes home so tired.

The people here are very kind and very on top of their business. My pup Bear seemed to have had a great time (I appreciated getting to watch him on the online cameras!) and is super tired after a big day. They have multiple parks at the …
Always a great time for Sir Percival. Staff is first rate and accommodating.
